Clear iTRAK Faults and method error warnings 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Acknowledges and clears faults and method errors on iTRAK. When executed, the instruction will clear axis faults on the axis and/or clear method warning.
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1001 Device Handler is not in a running state. Verify Ethernet modules and motion group state 1003 Device Handler is not in a supported state. Device Handler must be in state Available. Verify Ethernet modules, motion group state and that the Device Handler has been configured
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 4,0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction. 3.1 - Event fields match Machine Builder standards order. 3.0 - iTRAK Medium Frame Device Handler 3.0.00. Hndl structure modified to support both iTRAK Medium Frame and iTRAK5730 parameters. 1.0 - Release
